provenance.note: A child who survives every filter to the outbound document: youth-flagged, a youth date of birth, a middle name, both ethnicity descriptions, two defendantCaseJudicialResults so postHearingCustodyStatus reaches a real value, an associated defence organisation, a two-entry defendantAttendance with the youth's record SECOND (defect C8), and a prosecuting-authority court application.
provenance.operatorDescription: Runs the transform twice. Variant "fresh-payload" re-reads the inputs; variant "shared-payload" feeds the SAME in-memory hearing object to the second run.
provenance.operatorRationale: A re-shared hearing is delivered twice, and SetCourtRegister mutates the hearing it is given — DefendantContextBaseService writes level/prosecutionCaseId/offenceId/offenceTitle onto judicialResult nodes, and RegisterFragmentService REPLACES judicialResultPrompts with the court-extract-filtered subset. "fresh-payload" is the honest re-delivery and is the parity obligation: same bytes in, identical register out. "shared-payload" is a NEGATIVE CONTROL and is marked PRODUCER_IMPLAUSIBLE, because two deliveries cannot share a JS object: each is a separate orchestration whose hearing arrives through HearingResultedCacheQuery as freshly parsed JSON, and every callActivity argument crosses a serialisation boundary (lib/boundary.js). Its value is that it MEASURES that the mutation cannot cross a delivery; a future change that makes the two variants diverge is a harness defect, not a discovery.

operatorDetail.why: negative control: the same object in, and the output must STILL be identical
